M-VOICE-GATEWAY.Summary: HTTP entry point and orchestration layer for voice, text, dialogue FSM, LLM intent routing and response generation.

M-1C-ADAPTER.Summary: Integration adapter for 1C MCP Toolkit: stock queries, vehicle and part lookup, supply source selection and document creation (ЗаказНаРемонт, ПеремещениеТоваров, ЗаказНаПеремещение, ЗаказПоставщику).

M-OBSERVABILITY.Summary: In-process timings, LM token metrics, trace aggregation and diagnostics.

M-STT.Summary: Russian speech recognition service based on faster-whisper.

M-TTS.Summary: Russian speech synthesis service based on Piper.

M-MOCK-1C.Summary: Deterministic test double for stock and order operations.

M-WEB-CHAT.Summary: Browser voice/text dialogue client with VAD, cart panel and tables.

M-WEB-MONITOR.Summary: Browser monitoring UI for latency, LM token and trace metrics.

DF-VOICE-TURN.Summary: Browser audio -> STT -> gateway -> LLM intent -> 1C operation -> TTS -> browser response.

DF-PART-ORDER.Summary: Vehicle selection -> part selection -> stock-source decision -> repair/supply document creation.

DF-STOCK-QUERY.Summary: Stock request (voice or text) -> gateway stock routing -> 1C adapter query (mock fallback) -> answer/tables.

DF-OBSERVABILITY.Summary: Runtime timings and trace evidence from gateway to monitoring UI.
